rationale: CCH1 is a 50/50 HASI-KKR co-investment, aggregation and financing vehicle. It holds a mixed portfolio of equity-method investments, receivables and debt securities, is serviced through HASI affiliates, and has no evidenced standalone workforce or customer-facing operating business. The active legal entity and its senior notes do not convert it into a manager-level operating portfolio company.

repoReconciliation.preserve: canonical identity, aliases, 50/50 vehicle ownership and durable exclusion lineage

proposalGuardrails: Retire and unpublish the PortCo record while preserving its exclusion history and source evidence.

Do not label KKR Core Infrastructure as an exact named fund; the specific fund or account is not publicly disclosed.
Preserve the 50/50 HASI CarbonCount Holdings 1 / Hoops Midco membership as vehicle ownership context, not operating-company ownership.
Do not infer an exact formation or interest-closing day beyond the May 4, 2024 agreements and May 7 announcement.
Keep the 2025 and 2026 notes as financing-vehicle milestones, not proof of operating-company debt.
recommendedNextAction: Prepare one later protected exclusion and publication-retirement proposal for CarbonCount Holdings 1 LLC, preserving all lineage and without adding underlying projects automatically.
